supersedes: data/positive_control.json (voided: IMvigor210 gene identity invalid at that run)
purpose: P0-2 submission gate RERUN: the Ayers et al. JCI 2017 IFN-gamma 6-gene signature pushed through the SAME frozen transport pipeline and two-criterion evaluation as the main analysis, now with the RECOVERED IMvigor210 gene identity (exmat row j == j-th fData row in upper-cased symbol alphabetical order; see imvigor_gene_recovery.json)

signature.name: IFN-gamma 6-gene signature (Ayers et al., JCI 2017)
signature.score: mean of per-gene z-scores; z parameters frozen on the IMvigor210 labeled patients (n=298) and transported unchanged

recovered_key.definition: exmat row j (1-based) == fData row with the j-th symbol in alphabetical order of the upper-cased fData symbol column
recovered_key.evidence: imvigor_gene_recovery.json: sex-anchor gates PASS, 31085/31085 numeric identity match vs labeled mirror, upstream provenance byte-identical

frozen_pipeline.imvigor_loader: load_imvigor_correct (THIS script): recovered-key row selection -- the ONLY change vs the voided run
frozen_pipeline.external_loaders: verbatim from pca_stability.py (load_gse165252 / load_gse78220); gene labels valid in both
frozen_pipeline.training: IMvigor210 labeled patients n=298; per-gene z (log1p CPM, full-matrix library size) frozen; signature = mean of the available genes' z; univariate ridge logistic lambda=1/n_train, intercept unpenalised (verbatim // algebra)
frozen_pipeline.transport: z mean/sd and model coefficients frozen on the anchor, applied unchanged to ALL labeled patients of the target cohort (the same held-out sets as the main analysis)
frozen_pipeline.metrics: verbatim  benchmark metric set (metrics_block from competitor_benchmark.py): AUC + 2000-rep bootstrap BCa 95% CI (seed 20260911), logit-scale calibration slope, calibration-in-the-large (intercept), Brier, log-loss; within-cohort Efron 0.632 (n_boot=600, seed 20260911)
frozen_pipeline.variants: primary logcpm_z all-available-genes; sensitivity raw_z; sensitivity logcpm_z defined-genes-only

adjudication_rule.c1_main: external AUC bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0.5 in the beneficial direction (CI lower bound > 0.5)
adjudication_rule.tolerance_semantics: registered before execution: at tier t, C1 passes if CI lower bound > 0.5 - t; C2 passes if |slope - 1| <= t; tiers +/-0.05, +/-0.10, +/-0.20

within_imvigor210_efron632.lambda_rule: 1/n (within-cohort n, intercept unpenalised; identical algebra to M2)
within_imvigor210_efron632.formula: AUC_0.632 = 0.368 * AUC_apparent + 0.632 * mean(AUC_out-of-bag over 600 bootstrap refits)

GSE165252.lambda_rule: 1/n (within-cohort n, intercept unpenalised; identical algebra to M2)
GSE165252.formula: AUC_0.632 = 0.368 * AUC_apparent + 0.632 * mean(AUC_out-of-bag over 600 bootstrap refits)

GSE78220.lambda_rule: 1/n (within-cohort n, intercept unpenalised; identical algebra to M2)
GSE78220.formula: AUC_0.632 = 0.368 * AUC_apparent + 0.632 * mean(AUC_out-of-bag over 600 bootstrap refits)

new_s0_comparison.source: data/imvigor_gene_recovery.json phase2.new (recovered-key anchor arm, same frozen-transport design)

verdict.p0_2_question: is the two-criterion frozen-transport framework a trivial rejector?
verdict.statement: IMvigor210-anchored IFN-gamma 6-gene positive control (recovered gene identity): GSE165252: AUC 0.561 [0.422,0.712], slope 0.489, main-rule FAIL; GSE78220: AUC 0.494 [0.247,0.721], slope 0.250, main-rule FAIL. Any cohort passes main rule: False; at tiers pm0.05/pm0.10/pm0.20: False/False/False.
